latestVersion.changelog:
bridge-stablecoin 0.1.0

- Initial release of the bridge-stablecoin skill.
- Supports USDC bridging using Circle Bridge Kit SDK and Crosschain Transfer Protocol (CCTP).
- Enables bridging USDC between EVM chains, EVM chains and Solana, and any chain to any chain with Circle Wallets.
- Provides setup instructions, adapters for key management, event handling, error handling, and retry logic.
- Includes Forwarding Service option for automatic attestation and mint on destination chains with configurable transfer speeds.
